name: Grid Resolution Heuristic
aliases: Surface Area Metric for Density Optimization
Surface Area Metric for Grid Density
definition: A method to compute optimal grid densities (λ) for leaf levels using the Surface Area Metric to minimize expected traversal cost.
summary: The Grid Resolution Heuristic determines optimal uniform grid cell counts for ray tracing by using the Surface Area Metric to balance traversal and intersection costs, adapting density to scene geometry rather than using static choices.
